steps.content: Sensing through the shackles, you move in the direction of Zoya. Along the way, you keep coming across Corruptors that have come into being because of the contamination. They slow you down.
There are no humans in sight; the sheriffs and gangsters who stood in your way have all become Corruptors. The lines of defense barriers in the square are now unmanned.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: At least now we're not fighting the authorities; we don't have to explain our stance to Corruptors. Makes things easier for Chief.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...Quite the opposite. This is worse.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: I'd rather take on humans, however obnoxious they might be... and fight them with my water pipe, instead of just waking up one day and finding out that everyone has become a monster all of a sudden.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Hold on. That underboss of the Legion doesn't have any means of resisting contamination either. Could he have been...

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: That would mean trouble. Earl is a Sinner; if he goes manic and becomes Deteriorated, he will be a more troublesome enemy, based on what we've seen in the SALVA.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...I don't want to fight any more Legion members, and definitely not Horo's brother.
We should've put the shackles on him, even if it meant using some dirty trick or taking some tough measure.
You quicken your pace at the thought. You have so many things to ask him—about the inheritance that's appeared in the square, about the conspiracy behind the negotiation, about Zoya.
A dense crowd of Corruptors, however, blocks your way.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Tsk, why now? Why are there so many of them here?

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Could it be the FAC machines over there?

It's those towering machines again. There aren't many of them, but they've been deployed strategically around the square, centering on the conference hall. They're casting blue light into the depths of contamination.
Come to think of it, Corruptors along the way seem to have given these FAC machines a wide berth. Could this be the technology the FAC uses to fight Mania contamination?

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: These are the FAC's base stations for contamination shielding. I hear they can excite <color=#fb9259>Hypercubes</color> to produce a force field to protect the city, but the effect is limited.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: This one seems out of order. We have to make a detour.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Wait. They're mauling something... Look at the clothes... A Legion member?
Or rather, already a Corruptor. It makes a gurgling hiss, creeping closer to you with the creeping shadows behind it. The Sinners are still under some unknown pressure. A difficult situation overall.
You glance at the silent machines; they haven't come to much damage. If you can find a way to reboot this defense mechanism, things might work in your favor.
